elements.name: subtitle
elements.text: Existing execution and proxy mechanisms reduce work. AI4R retains the research and lab-wide contracts.

elements.name: source
elements.text: Pinned source: upstream JiuwenSwarm 02b37f47. Source inspected; no integrated runtime tests claimed.

Our need	JiuwenBox provides	Integration / remaining responsibility
Tool execution	Command, file, Python / JS operations through an API	Map CC operations and outcomes to AI4R contracts
Process restrictions	Bubblewrap; filesystem / network policies; optional CPU, RAM and PID limits	Qualify effective policies; Docker owns OCI execution
Job control and stop	Background job controls; sandbox stop / restart; graceful shutdown then signals	Connect Docker jobs; verify termination and preserved data
Model API transport	Path-prefix forwarding to endpoints and API-key injection	Supply aliases, feature checks, model pins and scoped access
Operational state	Persisted sandbox lifecycle records and audit events	AI4R owns research state, accepted results and backup / restore
Whole-lab operation	A Linux sandbox service we can reuse inside the VM	Provider owns VM stop; AI4R owns research, factory and qualification
